# Parivar Restaurant

> Authentic Royal Nizami Indian & Mughlai Cuisine in Wiley Park, Sydney. 100% Halal Certified. Open late until 3:00 AM daily.

## Overview
Parivar Restaurant is a premier Indian restaurant situated in Wiley Park, South West Sydney (Canterbury-Bankstown region). Specializing in traditional royal Nizami and Hyderabadi recipes, Parivar delivers authentic slow-cooked dum biryani, clay-tandoor grilled meats, rich curries, freshly baked naan breads, and handcrafted desserts.

- **100% Halal Certified**: All meats and dishes strictly adhere to Halal culinary standards.
- **Late-Night Dining**: Open every night until 3:00 AM (Mon–Sun).
- **Service Types**: Dine-in, Takeaway, Online Ordering, and Event Catering.

## Key Facts & Location
- **Address**: 1/83 King Georges Rd, Wiley Park NSW 2195, Australia

## Menu & Signature Offerings
- **Tandoori & Entrées**: Tandoori Chicken (Half / Full), Chicken Tikka, Sheekh Kebab, Fish Fry (Basa), Chicken 65.
- **Curries (Chicken & Mutton)**: Chicken Tikka Masala, Butter Chicken, Chicken Korma, Chicken Masala, Mutton Vindaloo, Mutton Khorma, Mutton Masala.
- **Vegetarian Curries**: Daal Tadka, Mixed Veg Curry, Paneer Tikka Masala.
- **Desi Chinese**: Chicken Fry Noodles, Veg Fry Noodles, Schezwan specialties.
- **Fresh Tandoori Breads**: Plain Naan, Garlic Naan, Butter Naan, Roti.
- **Traditional Desserts**: Gulab Jamun, Rasmalai, Shahi Tukda, Zafrani Kheer, Khowa Puri.
- **Beverages**: Authentic Spiced Chai (Small / Large), Sweet Mango Lassi, Soft Drinks.

## Catering & Events
Parivar provides full-service Indian catering for Sydney weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, and religious celebrations. Packages feature live chaat stations, tandoori grills, royal biryani handis, and traditional dessert buffets.
Contact: +61 405 635 423
